descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S08 「房号标签和建议的边界：床位字母、共用房间、相近的房号、空房间、句子中间的房号、说出来的数字、开头的临床数字；绝不给出另一个模式或另一个医生的」 Room chip and suggestion edges: bed letter, shared room, similar rooms, empty room, room mid-sentence, spoken number, a clinical number at the start; never another context or another physician

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 4；TFA-92582 step 4；TFA-92583 AC 3）
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 2；TFA-92583 AC 2）
  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 8）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given QA Hosp Patel 415A, QA Hosp Rivera 415B, QA Hosp Ames 1415, QA Hosp Bell 4150, QA Hosp Quinlan 112, QA Hosp Diaz 4B-12; nobody in room 630. Nursing Home resident QA Resident Moss in unit/room 415. A second @roundai.test physician with QA Hosp Other in room 415 and a compartment 'Bed 415, PHI canary 7Q.'

When Type into one box, replacing the text each time: 'Bed 415A, pain controlled, ambulating.', 'Bed 415, family meeting this afternoon.' (then search '415' in the picker), 'Bed 630, awaiting transfer from the ICU.', 'Seen with family, moved from the ICU to room 415A overnight.', 'Bed four fifteen A, stable.'; …

Then 415A suggests Patel only; 415 never offers rooms 1415 or 4150, the Nursing Home resident or the other physician's patient, and the chip follows the new text; the picker search for '415' lists this physician's Hospital patients only; 630 shows the chip with no suggestion and still offers Assign to patient; the other physician's box never shows; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain 'Rm 415A', '415A · QA Hosp Patel'; mustNotContain '415B · QA Hosp Rivera', '1415 · QA Hosp Ames', '4150 · QA Hosp Bell'. cp2 mustContain 'Rm 415'; mustNotContain 'Rm 415A', 'Rm 4150' (the chip follows the text), '1415 · QA Hosp Ames', '4150 · QA Hosp Bell' (our reading, Q3), 'QA Resident Moss', 'QA Hosp Other' (U8, other physician). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both (single-account cells) / local (other-physician cell) 跑；来源：dev。
